claims.claim: Ericsson's SEC-filed 2026 reporting shows Q1 organic sales growth of 6% led by Networks and disclosed AI-native radios, while its July 14 filing confirms publication of Q2 2026 results; the Q1 record also shows SEK 3.8 billion restructuring charges affecting reported EBITA.

risks.risk: Currency headwinds and restructuring costs can obscure or offset underlying network-demand improvement; product announcements do not establish scaled customer adoption.

unknowns.unknown: This source pass did not retrieve the full Q2 exhibit details needed to quantify whether Q1 organic momentum persisted into Q2.

claims.claim: Q1 evidence supports broadening demand and product-level AI-radio execution, but restructuring and currency effects require Alpha to separate operational improvement from reported-profit noise before underwriting.

risks.risk: AI-native radio positioning is an execution signal, not evidence of durable incremental economics until customer deployment and margin contribution are demonstrated.

unknowns.unknown: Full Q2 operating metrics remain to be source-addressed from the exhibit attached to the July 2026 6-K.
